connector.name: Openrouter Multimodal
connector.registryDescription: Chat with 300+ LLMs via OpenRouter. Analyze and generate images, audio, and video from MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package openrouter-mcp-multimodal. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stabgan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key. Get one free at https://openrouter.ai/keys

env.name: OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL
env.description: Default model for chat + analyze tools. Defaults to nvidia/nemotron-nano-12b-v2-vl:free.

env.name: OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Sandbox root for save_path on generate_* tools. Defaults to the current working directory.

env.name: OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS
env.description: Default max_tokens for chat_completion when unset in the request.

env.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_IGNORE
env.description: CSV of provider slugs to exclude.

env.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ORDER
env.description: JSON array or CSV of preferred provider IDs.

env.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_REQUIRE_PARAMETERS
env.description: true/false. Require providers to support all request params.

env.name: OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES
env.description: Enable response caching server-wide. Sends X-OpenRouter-Cache: true on every chat/analyze call unless overridden per-request. Zero tokens billed on cache hits.

env.name: OPENROUTER_INCLUDE_REASONING
env.description: Enable reasoning tokens passthrough server-wide. Adds _meta.reasoning to chat_completion responses for DeepSeek R1 / Gemini Thinking / Opus 4.7.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key. Get one free at https://openrouter.ai/keys
